title: Acme docs site with changelog
brief: Generate a small static documentation site for the fictional Acme CLI: three Markdown pages, a changelog page built from structured data, a dark/light/auto theme chosen by the operator, and an automated structure check. Output is a plain site/ folder.
constraints: Standard-library Python only. Work only inside the story workspace. No network access.

nodes.title: Level 2: tooling and the theme decision
Write the documentation pages
nodes.description:
Write three Markdown pages in content/: index.md, install.md and usage.md for the Acme CLI. Each page starts with a level-1 heading and links to the other pages with relative .html links.

[demo] story=S1_content scenario=normal run=none files=content/index.md,content/install.md,content/usage.md
nodes.acceptance: Three non-empty Markdown files exist in content/, each with a level-1 heading, and index.md links to the other two.
nodes.rationale: Prose with consistent cross-links suits a mid-tier Claude model.

nodes.title: Write the version history data
nodes.description:
Create changelog.json: a list of objects with version, date (YYYY-MM-DD) and changes (list of short strings), newest data for versions 0.2.0, 0.2.1 and 0.3.0.

[demo] story=S1_changelog_data scenario=slow run=none files=changelog.json
nodes.acceptance: changelog.json parses as JSON and holds three entries, each with version, date and a non-empty changes list.
nodes.rationale: Small structured-data task; a free OpenRouter model is enough.

nodes.title: Implement the site generator
nodes.description:
Write build.py: it renders content/*.md plus changelog.json into site/index.html, one page per Markdown file, and site/changelog.html, and accepts --theme light|dark|auto.

[demo] story=S2_generator scenario=hang-once run=none files=build.py
nodes.acceptance: build.py exists and runs with python3 build.py --theme auto without errors once the inputs exist.
nodes.rationale: Code generation with a small test surface.

nodes.title: Write the site structure checker
nodes.description:
Write check_site.py: it inspects site/, confirms index.html and changelog.html exist, that every internal .html link resolves and that all pages use one theme, and writes report.json.

[demo] story=S2_checker scenario=cancel-once run=none files=check_site.py
nodes.acceptance: check_site.py exists and writes report.json with an ok field when run against a built site.
nodes.rationale: Self-contained script; a free OpenRouter model is enough.

nodes.title: HUMAN: Choose the site theme
nodes.description: Decide which colour theme the generated site should use: light, dark or auto (follow the reader's system). Record the answer in the acceptance summary as: Decision: theme=<light|dark|auto>.
nodes.acceptance: The operator has recorded one of light, dark or auto in the handoff summary.
nodes.scope: Operator decision limited to the theme choice; no agent workspace changes.
nodes.rationale: A taste decision that belongs to the operator.

nodes.title: Build and check the site with the chosen theme
nodes.description:
Run build.py with the theme the operator recorded in the earlier decision handoff, producing site/, then run check_site.py and report report.json. If no decision is recorded, stop and report that instead of guessing.

[demo] story=S3_build scenario=normal run=build files=
nodes.acceptance: site/index.html and site/changelog.html exist and carry the operator's chosen theme, and report.json shows ok=true.
nodes.scope: Run build.py and check_site.py; write site/ and report.json only.
nodes.rationale: Mechanical build-and-check step that must honour the recorded decision.
